gspot 0.1.0 · [Source definition](https://github.com/stefanionescu/gspot/blob/main/packages/cli/src/program.ts)

Write one setting; the key is the dotted path gspot list settings prints.

```text
gspot set [options] <key> [value...]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning  |
| -------- | -------- |
| `key`    | required |
| `value`  | optional |

## Options

| Flag              | Meaning                                                                       |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--version`       | Print the version and nothing else                                            |
| `--json`          | Print the documented JSON object instead of text                              |
| `--quiet`         | Print failures only                                                           |
| `--verbose`       | Print every command with its arguments and every ignore with its reason       |
| `--no-color`      | No color in the output                                                        |
| `-C <dir>`        | Run as if started in that directory                                           |
| `--reason <text>` | Optional explanation; require_reasons makes it required for loosening changes |
| `--scope <path>`  | Write into a scope table instead of the root                                  |
| `--replace`       | For a list: replace the whole list                                            |
| `--remove`        | For a list: remove the named items                                            |
| `--default`       | Delete the key so the shipped default applies again                           |
| `-h, --help`      | display help for command                                                      |
